In an interview with Reporter Otonashi, 
Taiki Shuttle answers that she is aiming 
to become Horse Girl of the Year.

Hearing her words, Reporter Otonashi 
couldn't hide her shock. After all, an 
Umamusume from the Sprint division had 
never once been chosen as Umamusume of the 
Year.

An unprecedented challenge, but... such 
things were trivial matters to Taiki 
Shuttle.

Taiki Shuttle cheerfully replied that if 
there hadn't been one yet, she'd become 
the very first sprint Horse Girl of the 
Year!
